title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 10499 vso (AKU HT 12756)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 10499 vso

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 12756

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 12756; AKU grapheme H0110 (AKU GR 305). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: H5 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 235, 235 (v4p12). Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 22, no. 235. Occurrence: line 21; find place Ramesseum; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 5.8 x 15.2 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Mittleres Reich, 12. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
